tools.name: get_tabs
tools.description: List every open tab with id, url, title, active flag and mine (created by this session). Read-only. Find a tab_id when the implicit target is not the one you mean. include_windows adds position, size, state and type of each window — needed before moving or tiling. Session tabs gone since the last call come back once in closed_session_tabs with the reason (closed, window_closed, replaced, closed_by_bridge).

include_windows.description: Also return the windows with bounds, state, type and tab count

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate a Chrome tab to a URL. Returns a preview of interactive elements with refs usable in click/type_text/hover.

url.description: Absolute URL, or a path resolved against the current page

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the visible viewport only (PNG), at the current scroll position, or one per viewport preset with presets. Read-only. Activates the tab in the background without stealing window focus, then restores the previous tab. Downscaled to ≤1568px: for fine print, element_screenshot with scale.

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

save_to.description: Absolute path: write the PNG there and return the path instead of the content

presets.description: Resizes the window per preset, then restores it; not phone emulation. A refused width is reported, not shot. save_to = directory

if_changed.description: Same pixels as the last screenshot of this tab: a note instead of the image. false = always send it

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by CSS selector or by a ref (n1, n2…) from get_interactives or navigate. A real pointer sequence: it can submit, open a dialog or navigate — use wait_after. Not idempotent; a native confirm() blocks the bridge: handle_dialogs first. Returns page_changed (url, title and DOM deltas: nodes, text, open, expanded, checked, dialogs, focus): the effect, without a screenshot; when the click opens or reveals something, the refs of the visible interactives follow, no get_interactives needed.

selector.description: CSS selector; ">>>" pierces shadow DOM. Ignored when ref is given

button.description: right opens the page context menu instead of activating the element

count.description: 2 emits dblclick after the two clicks, which is what selects a word or opens an editor

trusted.description: Real browser input (isTrusted) via chrome.debugger, main frame only: for widgets that ignore synthetic clicks

wait_after.description: Settle before returning: navigation waits for a page load, networkidle for quiet traffic

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Put text into an input, textarea or contenteditable, by selector or ref. Replaces the whole value through the native setter (React/Vue controlled inputs register it) and fires input and change. mode=keys emits keydown/input/keyup per character for autocomplete and masked fields: slower, use it only when mode=set leaves the field empty. Returns value_after; mismatch=true means the field did not keep the value: retry with mode=keys.

selector.description: CSS selector; ">>>" pierces shadow DOM. Ignored when ref is given

text.description: Value to type; empty string clears the field

mode.description: set = assign value; keys = per-char events (autocomplete/masked); trusted = real input via chrome.debugger, main frame

wait_after.description: Settle before returning: navigation waits for a page load, networkidle for quiet traffic

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read the page as text (default), markdown, raw HTML, or accessibility tree. Read-only. markdown keeps headings, links and tables at a fraction of the HTML cost. Expensive on big pages: HTML on a large table costs tens of thousands of tokens for data you filter anyway — prefer extract_table/extract for repeated content, get_interactives for click targets.

mode.description: text strips markup; markdown keeps headings/links/tables far cheaper than html; accessibility = a11y tree

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

save_to.description: Absolute path: write the page there and return the path instead of the content

tools.name: get_page_info
tools.description: Page metadata: title, url, visibility, doctype, charset, meta tags, scripts, stylesheets, links and forms. visibility=hidden means the window is minimized, covered or in the background: the page does not render (screenshots fail) and its timers slow down. dev.server names a dev server (vite, webpack-dev-server, next, nuxt) and dev.overlay carries the compiler message when an error overlay is open: read it before treating the page as valid.

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tools.name: query_dom
tools.description: Query DOM elements by CSS selector, returning structure, attributes, bounding rect, and computed styles.

selector.description: CSS selector; ">>>" pierces shadow DOM. Matches all, not just the first

limit.description: Max elements returned, from the top of the match list

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tools.name: get_css_styles
tools.description: Why an element looks the way it does: for each CSS property the winning declaration — selector, stylesheet, rule position, !important, @layer, @media — and the ones it overrides, like the Styles panel of DevTools; query_dom gives the computed value, this gives who set it. Read-only, from the CSSOM: stylesheets of another origin without CORS are opaque and listed by href; user-agent styles, @container and @scope rules are not evaluated. properties narrows the output.

selector.description: CSS selector; ">>>" pierces shadow DOM. Only the first match is inspected

properties.description: Only these, e.g. ["margin-top","--brand"]; margin covers its longhands. Omitted = every property a matching rule sets

include_inherited.description: Also inherited properties (color, font-*, custom properties) with the ancestor that sets them

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tools.name: read_console
tools.description: Read console messages captured since page load, incl. uncaught errors and unhandled rejections.

level.description: all merges every level in one chronological list

format.description: lines is compact; json keeps timestamps and stack traces

sourcemap.description: Resolve bundle.js:line:col frames to source files through their source maps

since.description: cursor from the previous read: only newer entries, nothing deleted

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

tools.name: monitor_network
tools.description: Monitor network requests. source=page: XHR/fetch hook (installed on first call); source=browser: all requests incl. static assets; source=websocket: connections and messages. format=har exports HAR 1.2.

source.description: page: XHR/fetch only; browser: static assets too; websocket: connections and messages

format.description: har exports HAR 1.2 for external tooling

since.description: cursor from the previous read: only newer entries, nothing deleted

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Block until a condition holds: element, text, function (JS expression; needs the "Allow user scripts" toggle), navigation (mode=spa for client-side routes), network_idle. Polls until timeout (10s element/function, 15s the rest) then **returns `found: false` with a reason instead of raising**: check it, or a failed wait reads as success. Read-only.

condition.description: element and text need selector or text; function needs expression

selector.description: condition=element; with condition=text it narrows the search to that subtree

text.description: Literal text to wait for (condition=text), matched case-insensitively

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Batch fill form fields with React-compatible events. Handles input, select, checkbox, radio, and textarea. Fields and submit take a CSS selector or a ref (n1, n2…) from navigate/get_interactives. With submit_selector it also submits, so a repeated call submits twice — not safe to retry blindly; after a submit, after_submit carries url, title and the text the page gained (the confirmation or the errors). Each field reports value_after and mismatch; page_changed carries the DOM delta, and the refs of what appeared.

selector.description: CSS selector; ignored when ref is given

value.description: Text, option value or label; for checkbox/radio "true"/"false"

checked.description: Checkbox/radio instead of value: true checks, false unchecks

fields.description: {selector or ref, value or checked} per field

submit_selector.description: Submit button to click after filling

submit_ref.description: Submit button as a ref, instead of submit_selector

wait_after.description: Settle before returning: navigation waits for a page load, networkidle for quiet traffic

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tools.name: element_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot cropped to one element or to a viewport region (PNG), optionally enlarged. Read-only. The cheapest image in the set, because it carries only the box you asked for — and with scale the way to read fine print: crop the box, zoom it, verify.

selector.description: CSS selector; ">>>" pierces shadow DOM. The element is scrolled into view first

region.description: Box in viewport CSS px (the rect frame of get_interactives/query_dom), instead of selector

scale.description: Enlargement of the crop, 1-4; output still capped at 1568px

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Send a key to the focused element (or to selector, focusing it first) as a real keydown/keypress/keyup sequence, so framework handlers fire. For typing a value use type_text; this is for Enter, Tab, Escape, arrows and shortcuts. Not idempotent: two calls send the key twice. Returns page_changed like click; when the key opens or reveals something, the refs of the visible interactives follow.

trusted.description: Real browser key (isTrusted) via chrome.debugger, main frame only

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tools.name: dismiss_overlays
tools.description: Dismiss cookie banners/modal overlays: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, then generic heuristic. Idempotent.

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

tools.name: get_interactives
tools.description: List actionable elements (buttons, links, inputs, [role], [onclick]) with ready-to-use CSS selector, label, position, flags. Prefer this over dumping HTML to discover selectors.

limit.description: Max elements returned; raise it on a dense page

visible_only.description: false also lists elements hidden or scrolled out of view

format.description: lines is compact; json adds full attributes per element

since.description: cursor from the previous list: only added (+), changed (~) and removed elements; same scope, frame and tab

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

tools.name: assert
tools.description: Assert a page condition, polling until timeout: element exists/visible (optionally with count or containing text), text on page, tab url/title. Patterns: substring, or "/…/" for regex. Recorded flows replay it as a test.

selector.description: Element the assertion is about; ">>>" pierces shadow DOM

state.description: attached means present in the DOM, visible also requires a rendered box

text.description: In the element (with selector) or anywhere on the page

timeout.description: Max ms to wait for the condition before failing

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one
